newsitem.title: USA: Amoco, Mobil trade Texas, Oklahoma interests.
newsitem.headline: Amoco, Mobil trade Texas, Oklahoma interests.

text.p: Mobil Corp and Amoco Corp said they exchanged interests in oil fields in Oklahoma and Texas in a deal that is not expected to significantly change annual production volumes for either company.

Mobil's Mobil Exploration & Producing U.S. subsidiary transferred to Amoco its interests in 29 fields located in the Ardmore, Arkoma and Anadarko basins of Oklahoma and the Texas Panhandle, the companies said.
In return, Mobil obtained Amoco's interest in the Mobil- operated Salt Creek Field Unit in West Texas, which has total current operated production of about 26,500 barrels per day.

The exchange increased Mobil's interest in the Salt Creek CO2 flooded field from about 40 percent to more than 70 percent, and positioned Amoco as the largest producer of crude in Oklahoma, the companies said.
Both companies are in the midst of restructuring programs aimed at cutting costs and boosting returns.
